activation.note: Activation covers planning, implementation, modification and review of divergence dispatch, including existing in-code routing. Broad task terms are explicitly restricted to train dispatch; unrelated normal artifact flow is excluded. Repository inspection and validator findings honestly require new observers rather than being claimed as immediately observable.

audit.summary: Every source segment survives at its claimed destinations, with the complete registry requirement and imperative-map prohibition available to the coder. Additional planning guidance is declared, no waivers or shared-node relocations are introduced, and the then clause expresses one registry-based routing obligation.

segmentChecks.note: The then clause retains the declared, schema-valid artifact_urn-to-train_id registry, actual Station Master reads, and the prohibition on imperative in-code routing; prefer/avoid reinforce the same obligation.
The dispatch_registry term and its empty source definition are recorded without inventing a definition.
Both the validator type and the complete test reference survive in audit and evidence.
Severity 3 is retained verbatim in verifier_detail and audit.
The strict disposition is retained as a literal label, with no unsupported enforcement semantics added.
The introduced_in version 3.127.0 is retained verbatim in audit.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the complete registry requirement and prohibition on imperative routing, while its planning and acceptance guidance remains within the source obligation. A weak planner can determine what to inspect, change, and test, and activation is deterministic once the two honestly declared observers are available.
